nodes.text: Metapneumovirus (HMPV). It's a virus that causes respiratory infections, often leading to symptoms like cough, fever, and shortness of breath. HMPV can affect people of all ages, but it's most commonly seen in young children, older adults, and those with weakened immune systems. https://t.co/UVtEGII7pC
